Support Tool

Time Clock Error Log Review

Structured root-cause analysis for time clock issues.

What it does

Upload a time clock's log files and get back a structured diagnosis: the root cause of the reported issue, the evidence behind it, and recommended next actions. It parses error codes, timestamps, and config values that are easy to misread by hand, so you spend less time hunting through logs and more time resolving the ticket.

When to use it

Reach for it on any clock malfunction - frozen clocks, connection or authentication failures, power problems, reader faults, punches not registering, or sync issues - including TT3, TT7, and TT10 devices.

It is not for general support questions without log files, Skyward or HR software issues unrelated to the physical clock, or network problems not tied to a specific device.

What to have ready

You'll be asked for three things before analysis starts:

  • Log files - one or more of app.config, application.conf, winsvc, emulatorservice.log, emulator.log, errors.txt, settings.xml.
  • Account name - the district or organization.
  • Issue description - what the customer reported.

If you're missing something, you can still say "proceed" and it will do what it can with what's provided, noting the gaps in the report.

Freezing issues: have the freezing questionnaire answered first (what's frozen, on which screen, whether you can connect remotely, how the clock is powered, etc.). The answers make the analysis far more useful - or proceed without and they'll be flagged as an outstanding item.
